### Meeting Info
* **This will be the last AllCoreDevs call held on a Friday, starting from call 143, scheduled for July 21, AllCoreDevs will be held at 14:00 UTC on Thursdays**
* [July 8, 2022, 14:00 UTC](https://savvytime.com/converter/utc-to-germany-berlin-united-kingdom-london-ny-new-york-city-ca-san-francisco-china-shanghai-japan-tokyo-australia-sydney/jul-8-2022/2pm)
* Duration: 90 minutes
* Youtube Stream: https://youtu.be/K_Cjn74lMSY
* Zoom: shared on #allcoredevs Discord server shortly before the call 

### Agenda

* Gray Glacier Updates 
* Merge Updates 
    * Sepolia Merge 
    * Ropsten & Sepolia `mergeNetsplitBlocks `
    * https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/254 
    * https://github.com/eth-clients/goerli/issues/98
        * Guidance for current PoA signers  
    * mev-boost updates 
* EIP Discussions 
    * [EIP-4444 updates](https://github.com/henridf/eip44s-proto/issues/1)
* Announcements: 
    * Next ACD: **Thursday** July 21, 14:00 UTC 
    * https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/564

comments.body: We should discuss the `mergeNetsplitBlocks` for ropsten and sepolia

I would like to give a status update on mev-boost, and the plan from Flashbots for the next months.
We want to start the discussion on some topics and hear your thoughts.

- Where we are: :partying_face: 
  - A permissionless protocol for validators to participate in MEV extraction
  - A stable relay that can connect to multiple builders
  - A block builder optimized for MEV extraction
  - 2 consensus clients ready for testing https://github.com/flashbots/mev-boost#consensus-clients-implementation-status
- What comes next:
  - call for testing! https://github.com/flashbots/flashbots-writings-website/pull/23
  - testing guide: https://github.com/flashbots/mev-boost/wiki/Testing
  - mev-boost adoption
  - data transparency
  - community
  - more builders https://github.com/flashbots/mev-boost/issues/145
  - a relay monitor https://github.com/flashbots/mev-boost/issues/142
- Open questions:
  -  https://github.com/flashbots/mev-boost/wiki/Research#open-questions
  - sealed bids https://github.com/flashbots/mev-boost/issues/179
 - mev-boost on goerli
 - mev-boost on proof-of-work? :exploding_head: 
 - questions? comments? hate-mail? love letters?
I would like to quickly discuss one potential clarification to the Engine API spec https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/254, it is related to `latestValidHash` cc @potuz
